src_sentence: The oldest published reference to the word pornography as in 'new pornographie,' is dated back to 1638 and is credited to Nathaniel Butter in a history of the Fleet newspaper industry.
translation: Il più antico riferimento pubblicato alla parola pornografia, intesa come "new pornographie", risale al 1638 ed è attribuito a Nathaniel Butter in una storia dell'industria dei giornali di Fleet.

src_sentence: Human fascination with sexual imagery has been a constant throughout history.
translation: La fascinazione umana per l'immaginario sessuale è stata una costante nella Storia della rappresentazione erotica.

src_sentence: Pornography has been referred by people as a means to explore their sexuality.

src_sentence: Comparative studies indicate higher tolerance and consumption of pornography among adults tends to be associated with their greater support for gender equality.

src_sentence: Gonzo is a form of content creation that attempts to put the viewer into the scene, this is commonly achieved by close-up camera work or performers talking to the audience; also called "wall-to-wall", gonzo involves some aspects of "breaking the fourth wall" between the audience and performers.
translation: Gonzo (pornografia) è una forma di creazione di contenuti che tenta di immergere lo spettatore nella scena; ciò si ottiene comunemente tramite riprese in primo piano o attori pornografici che parlano al pubblico; chiamato anche "wall-to-wall", il gonzo include alcuni aspetti della rottura della Quarta parete tra il pubblico e gli attori pornografici.

src_sentence: The Buddha himself said often that a woman's body is "a vessel of impurity, full of stinking filth.

src_sentence: Although this development resulted in a decline in rentals, the revenues generated over the Internet, provided much financial gains for pornography producers and credit card companies among others.

src_sentence: The word pornography was originally used by classical scholars as "a bookish, and therefore inoffensive term for writing about prostitutes", but its meaning was quickly expanded to include all forms of "objectionable or obscene material in art and literature".
translation: La parola pornografia fu originariamente utilizzata dagli studiosi classici come "un termine erudito e quindi inoffensivo per indicare gli scritti sulle prostitute", ma il suo significato fu rapidamente ampliato per includere tutte le forme di "materiale riprovevole o osceno nell'arte e nella letteratura".

src_sentence: Some issues of doxing and revenge porn had been linked to a few pornography websites.

src_sentence: When European travellers visited India in the 19th century, they were dismayed at the religious representation of sexuality on the Hindu temples and deemed them as pornographic.

src_sentence: Porn Studies, which began in 2014, is the first international peer-reviewed, academic journal that is exclusively dedicated to the critical study of the "products and services" identified to constitute pornography.

src_sentence: Pornography consumption is found to induce psychological moods and emotions similar to those evoked during sexual intercourse and casual sex. Pornography usage is considered a widespread recreational activity in-line with other digital activities such as social media or video games.

src_sentence: A study in 2008 found that among University students aged 18 to 26 located in six college sites across the United States, 67% of young men and 49% of young women approved pornography viewing, with nearly 9 out of 10 men (87%) and 31% women reportedly using pornography.

src_sentence: Nonetheless, pornography featuring heterosexual acts made for heterosexual consumers, comprise the bulk of what is called the "mainstream porn", marking the industry more or less as "heteronormative".

src_sentence: The 1969 legislation, instead of resulting in a decline in pornography production, led to an explosion of investment in, and commercial production of pornography in Denmark, which made the country's name synonymous with sex and pornography.

translation: La parola pornografia è un conglomerato di due parole della Lingua greca: πόρνος (pórnos), "fornicatore", e γράφειν (gráphein), "scrivere, registrare o descrivere".

src_sentence: The oldest artifacts, including the Venus of Hohle Fels, which is considered to be borderline pornographic, were discovered in 2008 CE at a cave near Stuttgart in Germany, radiocarbon dating suggests they are at least 35,000 years old, from the Aurignacian period.
translation: I manufatti più antichi, tra cui la Venere di Hohle Fels, considerata al limite della pornografia, sono stati scoperti nel 2008 in una grotta vicino a Stoccarda, in Germania; il Metodo del carbonio-14 suggerisce che risalgano ad almeno 35.000 anni fa, appartenenti all'Aurignaziano.
